verdict.rationale: The pack documents Business Registration Online (BRO) as the core online flow, but no cited page says a founder can start it without first creating or signing in to an account. The EFILE number is used together with a password by enrolled electronic filers, so it is not a keyless founder entry path, and "Submit documents" sits inside a CRA business account. The axis applies to a government online-filing service, but no keyless or file-number entry path is documented.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start the core online flow without creating an account first — the service's published pages document a keyless or file-number entry path
